newsitem.title: UK: Europe raw cotton demand focuses on nearby shipmen.
newsitem.headline: Europe raw cotton demand focuses on nearby shipmen.

text.p: Demand for raw cotton in most European markets continues to centre on supplies available for nearby shipment.
More business has resulted in West African and central Asian styles, though the number of offers in circulation has continued to decline. Sellers' asking rates are thus quite firm.

Most traders report that very little forward demand is in evidence. Few spinners are willing at this point to purchase new crop descriptions in significant volume. In Turkey, spinners' attention remains focussed on US current crop styles which they consider to be attractively priced compared with local cottons owing to the availability of US government lines of credit.
